QuestInfo.name: [Wedding] 100 Day Commitment
QuestInfo.0: See #bAmes the Wise#k in Wedding Village if you and your spouse would like to do a 100 Day Commitment Ceremony.
QuestInfo.1:
#b#p9201004##k of #m680000000# explains that the #b#e100 Day Commitment Ceremony#k#n can give new meaning to a wedding band, as well as more solidify the love of a married couple. After your wedding, see Ames the Wise in Wedding Village and hear more about ceremony.
#b(After the commitment ceremony, you need to exchange wedding band for a Lovebirds Wedding Ring. Wedding information updates upon re-log.)

0.0: Congratulations on your 30 Day Commitment Ceremony. It's a better time than any to look towards the future, so I'd like to ask you: Have you heard of the #b#e100 Day Commitment Ceremony#n#k?
0.1: You know that here at Wedding Village, you can hold a #b30 Day and 100 Day Commitment Ceremony#k, right? Now that you've held your 30 Day Ceremony, why not try for 100 Days?
0.2: Your 100 Day Commitment Ceremony will grant you #b#eanother wedding ring upgrade#k#n, as well as some #bother items for married couples#k. Be sure to come see me when you've been married for 100 days, and I'll be more than happy to tell you more about the Commitment Ceremony.

yes.0: I hope to see you again soon.

no.0: Don't let the word commitment scare you. Just think of it as a small ceremony between you and the person you've committed to.

1.0: I've been expecting you. You've decided to hold a 100 Day Commitment Ceremony? If so, I'll tell you how to proceed.
1.1: To conduct a 100 Day Commitment Ceremony, you'll need one #b#i5251016##t5251016##k. Purchase the ticket and bring it to #b#p9201013##k, and she will reserve the ceremony chapel for you.\nOnce the ceremony is done, you'll receive an #bupgraded Wedding Ring#k, a #b#t1112905##k, and a #b10 #t2030023#s#k that can be used to teleport to your spouse.

yes.0:
Please form a party of two with your spouse and bring a #b#t5251016##k to #b#p9201013##k. You can purchase a ticket from the #e#rCash Shop#k#n. The nun is to your right.

default.0: Please come see me when 100 days have passed from your wedding. I'll tell you how to conduct a Commitment Ceremony at that time. \r\nAlso remember that a Commitment Ceremony can't be conducted if you're in the middle of a divorce. It sounds like common sense, but you'd be surprised...
